title: Community Note
description: A new weapon: enemy shots that come near you get a note stuck on them and fly back at the doomposter who sent them.

title: Green God Candle
description: A rare drop: grab it and a giant green candle slams down and wipes every bear on screen.

title: Whale Sighting
description: Once a run a whale swims across the screen, bears scatter out of its path, and it leaves a trail of XP.
